arStrings.szText: Each cast of {c_important}Bombardment{/c} within {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds of the last calls down more demons, up to {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} additional.

{c_important}Bombardment{/c} is also a {c_important}Summon{/c} Skill and each impact has a {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|%|]{/c} chance to leave behind mutilated demons for {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} seconds that attack surrounding enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:DEMON_SWIPE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Bombardment{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and now only slams down demons randomly around yourself but demons continue to rain down around you for {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds afterward. This effect can stack up to {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} times.
Each cast of {c_important}Bombardment{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage to each enemy per hit.
Each time {c_important}Bombardment{/c} throws a demon it has a {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} chance to also throw a surrounding {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} at your target location.
{c_important}Bombardment's{/c} chaotic spread is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} and it deals {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage when only hitting a single enemy.
